_comment: Checked-in capability policy for the cross-SDK suite (read by orchestrator/test_runner.py).
Every capability a scenario lists under `requires` must appear in `capabilities`, and every SDK
must classify every capability as either `required` (the wrapper MUST advertise it as true; a
false/missing value fails the run and the gated scenarios still execute) or a reviewed
`unsupported` exception with a one-line reason (the gated scenarios are skipped). A capability
that is neither, or an SDK with no entry here, fails closed. Extra keys a wrapper returns from
/capabilities that are not listed in `capabilities` are ignored. Required entries are pinned by
evidence (passing CI lanes), not auto-enrolled from whatever a wrapper currently reports.
When an SDK gains support for an excepted capability, move it from `unsupported` to `required`.

capabilities.publishFail: POST /context/{id}/publishFail arms a one-shot publisher failure
capabilities.variableKeysMap: POST /context/{id}/variableKeysMap returns every experiment per variable key
capabilities.globalCustomFieldKeys: POST /context/{id}/globalCustomFieldKeys returns the union of custom field keys
capabilities.readyError: POST /context/{id}/readyError reports the error of a failed context
capabilities.holdouts: two-arm holdout resolution, advertised from a behavioral self-test
capabilities.holdout_arms: three-arm holdout resolution, advertised from a behavioral self-test

unsupported.holdouts: pinned python3-sdk branch has no holdout resolution; wrapper does not advertise it
unsupported.holdout_arms: depends on holdouts, which the pinned python3-sdk branch lacks
